test_policy.notes: Vassar does not require SAT/ACT; applicants declare in the applicant portal whether to include scores (declaration deadlines: ED I Nov 22, ED II and RD Jan 8). Vassar superscores and accepts self-reported scores; enrolling students must send official reports.

requirements.notes: School Report with counselor recommendation and transcript, one teacher evaluation, and a mid-year report. Informational alumni interviews are available on request and are not evaluative. 'Your Space' is optional. The page does not state the cycle year next to the deadlines. CSS Profile applies to all students, domestic and international.

deadlines.label: Financial aid (ED I)
deadlines.notes: CSS Profile (code 2956), IDOC; FAFSA for US citizens/permanent residents.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if English was not the primary language of instruction in the secondary schools attended for the last three years. TOEFL Essentials and IELTS General Training are not accepted. Duolingo scores must be sent directly from Duolingo. No minimum scores are published. Interviews (InitialView, Vericant) are recommended with TOEFL/IELTS.

english.notes: iBT, iBT Home Edition and PBT accepted; no minimum published.
IELTS Academic only; no minimum published.

aid.notes: Meets the full demonstrated need of all admitted students who apply for aid at the time of application; need-aware for international applicants. International students must apply for aid with their admission application; those admitted without aid are not eligible later. No aid for international transfer applicants.

tier_notes.engineering: No engineering major (3-2 dual degree with Dartmouth only).
